model.title: Title VIII Nursing Workforce Reauthorization Act of 2026
model.meta: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee · Sen. Jeff Merkley (D-OR)

summary.text: The bill would reauthorize federal nursing workforce development programs under the Public Health Service Act. It aims to support initiatives that help train, recruit, and retain nurses to address healthcare workforce needs across the country.
